name: onyouoffice
description: Create, convert, read and edit Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and Hangul (HWP) documents locally with Onyou Office. Requires the Onyou Office desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Make and edit real Office files on your computer
interface.longDescription: Build slide decks, spreadsheets, Word and Hangul (HWP) documents, convert between formats and edit existing files with structured changes. Documents are processed on your computer by the free, open-source Onyou Office desktop app, which must be installed first.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into a 6-slide presentation
Convert this PDF into an editable Word document
Build a budget spreadsheet from this CSV with totals
